headline: Oct 29: HSC and equivalent results to be published
summary: The Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee has confirmed the date for this year's Higher Secondary Certificate results.
details: Results for this year’s Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and equivalent examinations will be published on October 29.
The announcement was made by Prof Syed Akhtaruzzaman, chairman of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Dhaka.
The decision was finalized during a meeting held on Saturday with the education minister and the secretary of the education ministry.
Further details regarding the result publication process will be announced on October 26.

headline_marked: Tension in Pirojpur as [[witness against Saidi is buried]]
headline: Tension in Pirojpur as witness against Saidi is buried
summary: Freedom fighter Manik Pashari, who testified against Delwar Hossain Saidi, has died. Tension rose in Pirojpur as some locals and Jamaat-e-Islami leaders protested his burial.
details: Freedom fighter Manik Pashari, who testified against former Jamaat-e-Islami leader Delwar Hossain Saidi in the International Crimes Tribunal, has passed away.
Pashari died on Saturday morning at his daughter's house in Tungipara, Gopalganj, after being ill for two months.
After his body was brought to Pirojpur, he was given a 'Guard of Honour' at the district police lines. However, tension erupted as some local residents demanded he not be buried in the city.

Jamaat-e-Islami leaders and activists were seen stationed at various key locations in the city. Pirojpur district Jamaat assistant secretary Abdur Razzaq stated they were present to prevent any untoward incidents.
Razzaq also claimed that Pashari was not a freedom fighter and protested the 'Guard of Honour' given to him, though he denied that Jamaat was blocking the burial.

Pirojpur Sadar Police Station OC Mo. Shariful Islam confirmed that the body remains at the police lines. He stated that burial will proceed once the situation calms and instructions are received from higher authorities.
caption:
Tension erupts in Pirojpur over the burial of a freedom fighter who testified against Delwar Hossain Saidi.

Freedom fighter Manik Pashari, who testified against former Jamaat-e-Islami leader Delwar Hossain Saidi in the International Crimes Tribunal, has passed away.

Pashari died on Saturday morning at his daughter's house in Tungipara, Gopalganj, after being ill for two months.

After his body was brought to Pirojpur, he was given a 'Guard of Honour' at the district police lines. However, tension erupted as some local residents demanded he not be buried in the city.

Jamaat-e-Islami leaders and activists were seen stationed at various key locations in the city. Pirojpur district Jamaat assistant secretary Abdur Razzaq stated they were present to prevent any untoward incidents.

Razzaq also claimed that Pashari was not a freedom fighter and protested the 'Guard of Honour' given to him, though he denied that Jamaat was blocking the burial.

Pirojpur Sadar Police Station OC Mo. Shariful Islam confirmed that the body remains at the police lines. He stated that burial will proceed once the situation calms and instructions are received from higher authorities.
